title: Pythagorean Theorem and Special Right Triangles
seo_title: Pythagorean Theorem and Special Right Triangles Worksheet (Geometry) | 100 Questions
short_title: Pythagorean Theorem and Special Right Triangles
standard_text: Prove theorems about triangles. Theorems include: a line parallel to one side of a triangle divides the other two proportionally, and conversely; the Pythagorean Theorem proved using triangle similarity.
meta_desc: Free Geometry worksheet on the Pythagorean theorem and special right triangles: radical answers, the converse, 45-45-90 and 30-60-90 triangles, and word problems. 100 questions.
key_sub: Compare c² with a² + b² to tell right, acute or obtuse.
body_html:
How it works

Pythagorean Theorem: in a right triangle, a² + b² = c², where c is the hypotenuse. To find a leg, subtract: a² = c² − b². Leave answers in simplest radical form: √50 = 5√2.

Converse: compare c² with a² + b² (c is the longest side). Equal: right. Smaller: acute. Larger: obtuse.

  • 45°-45°-90°: legs x, x; hypotenuse x√2.
  • 30°-60°-90°: shorter leg x (opposite 30°), longer leg x√3, hypotenuse 2x.
Example

The legs of a right triangle are 4 and 6. Find the hypotenuse.

16 + 36 = 52

√52 = √(4 × 13)

Answer: 2√13

Example

In a 30°-60°-90° triangle, the hypotenuse is 18. Find the longer leg.

Shorter leg = 9

Longer leg = 9√3

Answer: 9√3

Common mistakes

  • Adding the legs. With legs 3 and 4, the hypotenuse is √(9 + 16) = 5, not 7.
  • Adding the squares when finding a leg. Subtract from the hypotenuse squared.
  • Leaving √48 unsimplified. Take out the largest perfect square: 4√3.
  • Mixing up the legs of a 30°-60°-90° triangle. The shorter leg is opposite 30°.

faq.a: In a right triangle, the squares of the two legs add up to the square of the hypotenuse: a² + b² = c².

faq.q: How do you tell if a triangle is acute, right or obtuse from its sides?
faq.a: Square the longest side and compare it with the sum of the squares of the other two. Equal means right, less means acute, more means obtuse.

faq.q: What are the side ratios of a 45-45-90 triangle?
faq.a: 1 : 1 : √2. The hypotenuse is a leg times √2.

faq.q: What are the side ratios of a 30-60-90 triangle?
faq.a: 1 : √3 : 2. The hypotenuse is twice the shorter leg, and the longer leg is the shorter leg times √3.

items.q: A triangle has side lengths 7, 24 and 25. Is it acute, right, or obtuse?
